title: Save Plugin Settings
description: Body of PUT /cms-api/v1/admin/plugins/{pluginId}/settings (contract C14). `values` maps a setting key of the plugin manifest to its new value: a value sets it (a secret is encrypted), null clears it, and a key that is left out stays as it is. Each value is checked against the type the manifest declares (string, number, boolean, url) by the service: 400 invalid_plugin_setting.
